subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` change its default uncertain-disconnect behavior to wait for and replay the accepted Gateway run before starting the existing isolated embedded fallback?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive CLI behavior choice involving response latency, streaming, delivery semantics, duplicated side effects, and the acceptable result when the original run cannot be proven; code review cannot safely choose that product policy alone.

options.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
options.body: Adopt bounded Gateway wait plus cache-only replay as the default, retaining isolated embedded fallback only after recovery is exhausted.

options.title: Keep fallback-first
options.body: Retain the current immediate fresh-session embedded fallback and close or narrow this branch to non-default recovery work.

options.title: Split by invocation mode
options.body: Use reattach-first only for a defined mode such as `--deliver`, while preserving current interactive behavior until separately validated.

recommendation.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
recommendation.body: Adopt bounded Gateway wait plus cache-only replay as the default, retaining isolated embedded fallback only after recovery is exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: The current fallback containment path was introduced in the merged change authored by this contributor, making them the strongest history-based routing candidate for the default-policy decision.
